I don't have any notes to give you yet. My research tool was cut off before I could read a single page, so I have nothing sourced to report.

**What happened:**
- I tried to open the main verse-by-verse sources directly: Enduring Word on 2 Chronicles 13, and the Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary and Gill pages on biblehub.com. The tool refused all four. It only opens addresses that have first come up in a search.
- I then set up searches for Enduring Word, Ellicott, Pulpit, Gill, Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. I also planned topic searches on:
  - the "covenant of salt" (v. 5)
  - the Abijah/Abijam differences with 1 Kings 15 (vv. 1–2)
  - Abijah's speech on Mount Zemaraim (vv. 4–12)
  - the very large army numbers (vv. 3, 17)
- That search never ran because I had hit my limit of tool calls for this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for every point, and not to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any notes from memory; they would have no checked source behind them.

**Next step:** if you reply (even just "continue"), I can run those searches. Then I'll read the pages and write the notes as you asked, verse by verse with a URL after each point:
- the traditional reading
- where Protestant traditions differ
- other views, including modern scholarship, Catholic and Orthodox readings, and popular modern teaching

If you'd rather go in stages, I can start with Enduring Word and the biblehub commentaries and add the other sources after.
